clips.title: The story
paras: At the northern edge of Raven Hill Cemetery, Forlorn Rowe lies under a shadow of dread. Morbent Fel makes his home on the hill, and his magic raises the restless dead across Duskwood.

Forlorn Rowe rises along the northern edge of Raven Hill Cemetery, its slope lost in gloom. Morbent Fel makes his home atop the hill. The necromancer is responsible for much of the walking dead that haunt the surrounding wilderness. From this height, he directs his skeletal servants with foul enchantments, making Duskwood’s northwestern corner perilous for travelers.
